newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks firmer, Podravka takes spotlight.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks firmer, Podravka takes spotlight.

text.p: Almost all Croatian stocks firmed on Tuesday with food concern Podravka taking the spotlight in a lively trade and traders expected the price rise to continue.
"I believe there are no factors that could interrupt the bull run, typical for January," said Josko Milisa of investment consultants and brokers I.F.C.
Ten of 12 active issues were up, one down and one was flat.
Volume almost tripled to 15,474 shares, and turnover also rose to 5.9 million kuna.
Top gainer, food processor Podravka, climbed 16 kuna to 255 and was the most actively traded issue with 8,933 units sold.

"Podravka got rid of its loss-making units...completing the best part of its restructuring, " said Milisa, adding that this paved the way for an expected deal with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development.
Apart from Podravka, Milisa cited blue chips Pliva and Zagrebacka Banka as the most promising stocks.
Both reached new records on Tuesday, Zagrebacka gaining 65 kuna or 5.0 percent to close at 1,365 kuna on volume of 1,388 shares. Its GDRs peaked at $27.875 each on Seaq.
Pliva added eight kuna to 458, trading 1,030 units. Pliva's GDRs also rose to $17.63, another record in London.
Three hoteliers -- Laguna, Jadranturist and Istraturist were among gainers. But the most actively traded among them was Suncani Hvar, flat at 60 kuna on volume of 1,452 shares.
The only loser was cable maker Elka, which edged down five kuna to 190 with 55 shares sold.
The second tranche of public debt refinancing bonds traded at 8.45 percent above face value, compared to 7.10 percent almost a month ago. Bond turnover totalled 19.3 million kuna.
